user.title: Create Relative Light Group
user.description: Create a light group with relative brightness control. Brightness changes are distributed proportionally among lights that are on.

data_description.all: If enabled, the group is considered on only when all members are on. If disabled, the group is on when any member is on.
data_description.remember_on_state: If enabled, when the group is turned off and on again, only the lights that were previously on will turn on.
data_description.restore_individual_brightness: If enabled, when you turn the group off and on again from the group entity, each light that turns on is set to the brightness it had before the group was turned off. Lights without a stored brightness (for example on/off-only) turn on as usual. If you turn the group on with an explicit brightness, that value is used for all targets instead.
data_description.remember_brightness: If enabled, the group keeps brightness ratios between lights. Proportions are preserved even when the group reaches minimum or maximum brightness. Individual brightness can only be changed directly on each light, not from the group.
data_description.brightness_strategy: How the group brightness is calculated from the lights that are on. Average is the default.
data_description.member_diagnostics: If enabled, the group exposes compact per-member state and remembered brightness attributes for troubleshooting.
data_description.debounce_enabled: If enabled, the group ignores state updates from members for a short period after a command is sent, preventing the UI slider from jumping.
data_description.debounce_time: The amount of time in milliseconds to ignore member state updates.

error.invalid_domain: {entity_id} is not a light entity. Only entities from the 'light' domain are allowed.
error.self_reference: {entity_id} cannot be a member of itself.
error.nested_relative_group: {entity_id} belongs to another Relative Light Group; nesting is not supported.
error.empty_group: The group must contain at least one light.

error.invalid_brightness_strategy: The selected brightness strategy is invalid.

set_options.name: Update group options
set_options.description: Update one or more options of a Relative Light Group. Only the keys you send are changed; the rest are preserved. The group is reloaded after a successful change.

all.name: All entities must be on
all.description: If enabled, the group is considered on only when all members are on. If disabled, the group is on when any member is on.

hide_members.name: Hide members
hide_members.description: If enabled, the group's member entities are hidden in the entity registry.

remember_on_state.name: Remember on/off state
remember_on_state.description: If enabled, when the group is turned off and on again, only the lights that were previously on will turn on.

restore_individual_brightness.name: Restore individual brightness
restore_individual_brightness.description: If enabled, when you turn the group off and on again from the group entity, each light that turns on is set to the brightness it had before the group was turned off.

remember_brightness.name: Maintain relative brightness
remember_brightness.description: If enabled, the group keeps brightness ratios between lights. Proportions are preserved even when the group reaches minimum or maximum brightness.

brightness_strategy.name: Representative brightness
brightness_strategy.description: How the group brightness is calculated from lights that are on. Average is the default.

member_diagnostics.name: Expose member diagnostics
member_diagnostics.description: If enabled, the group exposes compact per-member state and remembered brightness attributes for troubleshooting.

debounce_enabled.name: Enable optimistic state debounce
debounce_enabled.description: If enabled, the group ignores state updates from members for a short period after a command is sent, preventing the UI slider from jumping.

debounce_time.name: Debounce time
debounce_time.description: Milliseconds to ignore member state updates after a group command (only effective when the optimistic debounce is enabled).

add_lights.name: Add lights to group
add_lights.description: Append one or more lights to the group's member list. Lights already in the group are ignored. Lights that belong to another Relative Light Group are rejected to prevent circular references.

entities.name: Lights to add
entities.description: One or more light entities to add to the group.

remove_lights.name: Remove lights from group
remove_lights.description: Remove one or more lights from the group's member list. Lights not in the group are ignored. The group cannot be left empty; the call is rejected if the resulting list would be empty.

entities.name: Lights to remove
entities.description: One or more light entities to remove from the group.

set_lights.name: Replace group lights
set_lights.description: Replace the group's member list with the provided lights. The list cannot be empty and cannot contain entities that belong to another Relative Light Group.

entities.name: Lights
entities.description: New ordered list of light entities for the group.

no_target.message: No target group entity provided. Use 'target.entity_id' with a Relative Light Group entity.

no_valid_target.message: None of the targeted entities belongs to a loaded Relative Light Group: {entities}.

no_options.message: No options provided. Send at least one option to change.

invalid_domain.message: {entity_id} is not a light entity. Only entities from the 'light' domain are allowed.

self_reference.message: {entity_id} cannot be a member of itself.

nested_relative_group.message: {entity_id} belongs to another Relative Light Group; nesting is not supported.

empty_group.message: The group {group} cannot be left empty.
